Fence (TvT, Deathmatch)

An ellipse nobody gets through in a Team vs Team or Deathmatch match, players or fake players; whoever gets beyond it anyway is brought back inside. It must hold every base and Deathmatch spawn. Conquest doesn't use it. Drag its middle or its east and south handles on the map.

How it works

One map serves every event it is ticked for: the area, the fence and the doors are shared, and each event has its own points. Pick the event under “Points of” to place and edit its points; the other events' points show faint. Drag points, the fence and the area's corners on the map; drag elsewhere to pan, wheel to zoom. “+ on map” places points where you click (Shift: several), “+ here” and “Here” where you stand in game (facing the way you face), “TP” takes you there. Every point takes the height of the ground under it at once, and again when you save. Team vs Team: each base is a ring of TvTBaseRadius (safe for its team, a stun trap for the other); a team starts at its first base. Conquest: the spawn points of each team (the ring is how far a wave spreads) and the capture points. Deathmatch: the spots everyone spawns at, each fighter at one picked by chance (“Scatter” puts open ground spots on the field for you). A match is played in a copy of the place with only the doors named here: click a door on the map (or pick in the Doors list) to put it in the match open or shut. Saving writes data/maps/<id>.xml and redraws the waypoints of anyone showing the map in game (//tvt show).

    New map around you

    The area starts 16000 × 16000 around where you stand in game, without points or fence, used in no event yet.
